words.sentence: In spring, the flowers come out.
words.def: This season comes after winter. Flowers start to grow.

words.sentence: We go to the beach in summer.
words.def: This is the hottest season. Lots of people go to the beach.

words.sentence: The leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
words.def: In this season, leaves fall from the trees.
This is the coldest season. Sometimes it snows.

words.sentence: December is the last month of the year.
words.def: There are twelve of these in a year. January is one of them.
